                     8   services that Accelalpha performed.

                    10          6.      Extreme Networks is a publicly-traded provider of wired and wireless networking

                    11   products and services. In early 2023, Extreme Networks launched a project to upgrade and

                    12   replace a number of its internal computer systems. As one part of this larger project, Extreme

                    13   Networks entered into the Agreement with Accelalpha, under which the latter was retained to

                    14   work on Extreme Networks’ implementation of Oracle’s CPQ and SMC products. As Oracle

                    15   describes it, the CPQ product (Configure, Price, Quote) is a cloud-based application that helps

                    16   sellers configure the right mix of products or services and create accurate, professional quotes;

                    17   and its SMC product (Subscription Management) is a fully integrated, cloud-based subscription

                    18   management system for product- and service-based companies that simplifies the management of

                    19   contracts, billing, and revenue.
                    20          7.      Under the Agreement, the CPQ/SMC implementation was to be jointly performed,

                    21   with certain tasks assigned to Accelalpha, others assigned to Extreme Networks, and others

                    22   assigned jointly to both. Separately, Extreme Networks contracted with different consulting firms

                    23   to handle other aspects of the broader implementation project. The “system map” set forth in the

                    24   Agreement depicted various components of the broader project:
